title: Did Investors Force Nvidia to Bring Back Jensen Huang? #Shorts
description:
Did investors force Jensen Huang's return? A 'Stand with Jensen' petition, Altimeter's Brad Gerstner and Atreides' Gavin Baker urging the board to keep 'all options on the table', and Bill Ackman saying the board 'panicked'. But Huang never held a controlling stake - only the board could decide, and on 23 Nov it voted unanimously to reinstate him.

Sources (checked 24 Nov 2026):
- FT / CNBC on Altimeter and Atreides letter: https://digg.com/world-business/waz1jqs4
- Fox Business (Ackman): https://www.foxbusiness.com/business-leaders/bill-ackman-blasts-nvidias-board-over-jensen-huangs-ouster-says-panicked
- No controlling stake (FT via ZeroHedge): https://www.zerohedge.com/ai/jensen-white-huang-reportedly-weighs-nvidia-comeback-silicon-valley-war-room-allies-assembles
- NVIDIA 8-K, Huang reinstated (23 Nov 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000090/nov23pressrelease.htm

Allegations mentioned are reports, not proven facts. Our analysis is labelled as such. News, not financial advice.
